verses.1: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.2: Man knew about Jerusalem and its hardships.
verses.3: And you said, “Thus says the Lord Jehovah: I will take your wives and your daughters from the land of Canaan, from your father’s house. Your husbandmen and your flocks belong to me.”
verses.4: And from your mother’s womb, on the day you were born, your hair was not combed, and in the water, you were not bathed for purification. Your body was not washed clean, and your nails were not cut.
verses.5: I did not spare you from having to do one of these things for your sake. I threw you into the field, with your soul in despair, on the day you were born.
verses.6: And I will pass over you, and I will see that you are still alive in your land. And I will say to you, “In my land, I live.”
verses.7: You were like a vine that was planted in the field. You grew and multiplied, and I became great. But then, my enemies came against me. Your gates were broken down, and you became a ruin and a desolation.
verses.8: And I will pass over you, and I will look at you. Then, in that moment, I will spread my wings over you, and I will cover your shame with them. I will be your lover, and I will enter into a covenant with you. May the Lord say, “May you become mine.”
verses.9: And I will wash you with water, and I will wipe away your blood from you. And I will cover you with dust.
verses.10: And I will sew you up, and I will wrap you in cloth. I will also bathe you in water, and I will cover you with cloth.
verses.11: And I will bind you with ropes on your hands, and tie you tightly to your legs.
verses.12: And I will put cloves on your lips, and perfumes on your ears. And I will adorn you with beauty on your head.
verses.13: And she used gold, silver, and other precious metals; she also used silk, cloth, and leather. She ate everything that was available to her. She became very rich and successful as a queen.
verses.14: And he went forth to you in your beauty, for it is all in my power. I have placed this curse upon you, O Lord Jehovah.
verses.15: I will worship you with my whole heart, and I will pour out all my love upon you. I will give all my devotion to everyone who comes near you.
verses.16: And take some of your tears, and use them to make makeup for your eyes. Apply it on your eyelids, but do not let it get on your skin.
verses.17: And you shall take all your jewels from gold and silver, which I have given you. Then you shall make statues of them as memorials.
verses.18: And you shall take your clothes and cover yourself with them. I will also cover you with them. Then I will present you before them.
verses.19: And my blood, which I have given you, will be like salt and wine. It will be used as a fragrance before them. May the name of the LORD be praised.
verses.20: And you shall take your children and the children of your children who have been born to me, and you shall sacrifice them as food for those who are less worthy than me.
verses.21: And I slaughtered my children, and I gave them to others.
verses.22: And all your troubles and hardships, you didn’t remember those days from your youth. You were a source of annoyance and irritation to others.
verses.23: And after all your evils, oh, how sad for you! Alas, Adonai of Jehovah!
verses.24: And I built for you a high place, and I made it a hill in every direction.
verses.25: To every head that walks along your path, I will destroy your beauty. I will break your feet for every passerby. I will also destroy your lips.
verses.26: And I went to the children of Egypt, your neighbors. I grew up among them, and I made my presence known in order to provoke you.
verses.27: And behold, I laid my hand on you, and I cut off your hair. I will also cast you away among your enemies, those daughters of Philistia who have gone astray from your path.
verses.28: And I spoke to the sons of Ashur, because you did not repent. And they also did not repent.
verses.29: And he carried your baggage to the land of Canaan, as it was written. But even then, he did not rest.
verses.30: What am I to say to your daughter? O Lord Jehovah, for all these deeds you have done, it’s like a wicked woman who is causing trouble.
verses.31: In your creations, you have created every path and mountain. You’ve made everything in every corner of the world. But you weren’t like those who can easily be defeated by us.
verses.32: The woman who is under her husband’s authority will take away his hair.
verses.33: To all your lovers, I will give them nudes. You have given your nudes to all your lovers. I have destroyed them so that they can come to me from all around, through your nudity.
verses.34: And it happened that, among all the women, you were the most beautiful. But after that, no one else was as beautiful as you. And I didn’t give you any of them. So, you became the most beautiful of all.
verses.35: Therefore, listen to what Jehovah says.
verses.36: As Adonai Yehovah has said: “Because you have spilled your blood, and your evil deeds have been revealed in your actions toward your lovers and all those who suffer from your cruelty. And also, like your children, whom you gave to them.”
verses.37: Therefore, I am destroying all your lovers who have caused you harm. I also destroy everything you loved and cherished. I will cast them away from around you. I will make their evil known to them, so that they may see all your evil deeds.
verses.38: And you judge by unjust judgments and bloodshed. You also shed blood, both warm blood and blood of anger.
verses.39: And I gave you into their hands. They destroyed your chest, and they stripped off your clothes. They took away all your treasures, and they left you in a city of ruins and desolation.
verses.40: And a crowd rushed upon me, and they struck me with stones while I was lying in the ruins.
verses.41: And they burned your house with fire. They made judgments against you in front of many women. Your honor was destroyed, and I will not give you any more rewards either.
verses.42: And I will put my love in you, and my jealousy will be removed from you. I will be quiet, and I will no longer get angry.
verses.43: Because you did not remember your youth days, and you became angry with me in all these situations. But I still follow your ways. I have submitted myself to the Lord Jehovah. You did not do what was right in all your actions against me.
verses.44: Now, all those who rule over you will rule over me, saying, “As a mother rules over her daughter.”
verses.45: Your mother was a woman who suffered greatly, along with her children and siblings. You too are like them; you also suffered greatly. May God have mercy on you and your family.
verses.46: And your great sister is Shemeron; her daughters sit on your head. And your little sister, from your right side, is Sdom; and her daughters also.
verses.47: And not in their ways did you walk; and not according to their deceitful practices did you act. I have rejected them on all your paths.
verses.48: May my Lord Yehovah say: “If you have done this to your sister and her daughters, just as you have done to me and my daughters.”
verses.49: See, this was a terrible misfortune for your sister. She lost her child and her possessions. She became the property of those who were poor and needy.
verses.50: And we were made to suffer before them; we were subjected to humiliation. I saw it with my own eyes.
verses.51: And Shemoshon, because of half of your sins, did not sin himself. He removed all your troubles from you, and he justified your brothers in all the troubles you caused.
verses.52: And you too, in all your righteousness, will be justified in your sins. You who have sinned against your sisters, you will be justified by your righteousness. And you too, in all your righteousness, will be saved and justified by your sisterhood.
verses.53: And I restored the tribes of Sodom and its daughters, as well as the tribes of Shomeron and its daughters. And I also restored the tribe of Shabbitayk within their territory.
verses.54: So that you may carry out all your plans, and be satisfied with everything you have done in your kindnesses to us.
verses.55: And your sisters, Sdom and their daughters, shall be honored before you. And you and your daughters shall also be honored before them.
verses.56: And may your sister not be heard by you on the day of your judgment.
verses.57: Before your troubles become apparent, just as the daughters of Aram and all their surrounding areas were destroyed by the wicked daughters of Philistia.
verses.58: Your burdens and your sorrows, I will carry upon myself, O LORD.
verses.59: For thus said Adonai Yehovah: “I have done this, just as You commanded me to do. This is what I shall fulfill in accordance with Your covenant.”
verses.60: And I remember my covenant with you in your youth. I made a covenant with you for eternity.
verses.61: And remember your ways. You will be blessed when you take your older sisters from among you and give them to your younger ones. I will give them to you as gifts, not as a bond of marriage.
verses.62: And I will establish my covenant with you. You shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.63: So that I may remember and not be trapped again by your schemes. So that nothing will happen to you because of all those things you’ve done, O Lord Jehovah.
